Exact minimality: the escape law is equivalent to excluding every
deep-quiet terminal.  Hence proving the scheduler cover impossible is
precisely the remaining task; none of the redundant terminal inequalities
hide an additional route to contradiction.
changes.replacement:
Exact reformulation: the escape law is equivalent to excluding every
deep-quiet terminal. The scheduler cover above is a necessary consequence
for each present triple-packet value, not an equivalent exclusion principle.
A proof of the escape law must also handle an already empty triple packet.
changes.reason: The theorem equates escape with no terminal; it does not equate the scheduler cover with terminal existence, and cover arguments alone can be vacuous for an empty triple packet.
